arguments.sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', date) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions in each hour of the day, from 0 to 23, based on the transaction timestamp.
assumptions: Counts cover all transactions, labelled or not, over the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
Hour is taken from the transaction date timestamp as recorded, with no timezone conversion.
Hours with no transactions would be absent from the result rather than shown as zero.
